purpose: Normative design enumerations; no deployed implementation or observed account population is asserted by this file.

identity.trading_master_role: 0804-4932 is operational prior art, never an alias for either reporting master
accepted_account_forms: four ASCII digits, one hyphen, four ASCII digits
identity.normalization: Trim outer whitespace; remove the single approved hyphen; require exactly eight digits and prepend 00, or preserve a validated ten-digit 00-prefixed value. Excel numeric values qualify only if finite integral eight-digit values with no lost precision. Never pad a suffix, coerce a float/exponent string, or fuzzy-match.

workbook.extent: All used rows of the named sheet; the current 22-row extent is never a limit or a membership constant.
workbook.boolean_normalization: Trim outer whitespace and casefold; other values are INVALID, never truthy by coercion.
workbook.overflow_behavior: Fail closed with source error and observed extent. Never truncate and label the result complete.
workbook.snapshot_consistency: Read driveItem ETag before and after complete worksheet acquisition. Publish a snapshot only on equality, complete-page coverage, expected unique headers, and recognized row structure.
workbook.date_input: Accept ISO YYYY-MM-DD or an actual Excel date cell decoded with the workbook epoch. Reject ambiguous locale strings. Do not equate Inception Date or Last Trade Date with a proven first strategy trade.

registry_registration.authority: CTO97152: do not wait for the row to land the PRD or trigger review; address() resolves once the systems.json gateway row lands.

source_boundary.authority: CTO97115 F1 and CTO97131 source identity gateway; doctrine section 1; CLAUDE.md Rule 30 at a3d77717df
source_boundary.shipped_payload: The complete successful /ms/taxsma-workbook capability response. The seven-field projection happens at this source boundary; it is not an Opal Bronze rewrite of a full Graph worksheet.
source_boundary.bronze_bytes: Persist the successful JSON response body byte-for-byte, before parsing/reserializing it. Store retrieval metadata and SHA-256 outside those body bytes. Never retain excluded Graph columns.
source_boundary.bronze_partition: UTC knowledge date rendered compact YYYYMMDD under R9; the source dates in the response remain unchanged.

silver.trigger: Successful durable S02 Bronze acquisition is the event that invokes S19 within the existing bounded prelude; no independent clock, poller, queue or standing monitor. Replay of a receipt only repairs/verifies the same snapshot.
silver.format: Typed parquet; hive date=YYYY-MM-DD by UTC knowledge date; one immutable snapshot_id-response_sha256.parquet per complete response. response_sha256 hashes exact shipped body bytes; the existing logical snapshot_id remains content-based. Different acquisition envelopes for unchanged logical rows therefore never overwrite or collide with prior raw/Silver captures.
silver.rows: Every shipped row is retained, including ACCOUNT_SLOT, BLANK, TOTAL and UNRECOGNIZED. Deduplicate delivery replay by exact response_sha256 plus row_number only; distinct source rows with duplicate account identities remain distinct for S03/S04 to flag. Conflicting replay bytes are an error.
silver.columns: Retain all seven projected business columns and all three row_metadata fields. Retain every response envelope field except rows as typed Parquet file metadata, including for a zero-row snapshot. Include Bronze address/hash and snapshot_id provenance. No business filtering, column slimming, normalization of account values or membership selection here.
silver.typing: row_number is int64; row_kind is string and other_business_cells_present boolean. Each of the seven business columns retains its shipped scalar in a typed struct with a kind enum (STRING, INTEGER, FLOAT, BOOLEAN, NULL) and mutually exclusive nullable string_value, integer_value (int64), float_value (float64) and boolean_value fields; NULL has no populated value field. No padding, case folding, status parsing or date coercion occurs here. S03/S04 apply the existing business/identity parsers after reading the preserved scalar. The JSON capability rejects non-JSON NaN/Infinity; representable invalid business values remain evidence. Envelope counts are int64, complete is boolean, and identity/date/hash fields are strings with the contract meanings.
silver.consumer: S03 reads the complete validated Silver snapshot and its source lineage; Bronze remains immutable audit/replay evidence, never a direct membership shortcut.
silver.failure: Missing/corrupt/incomplete Silver is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or SOURCE_SCHEMA_INVALID with last-good lineage, never an empty or reduced expected population. Gold cannot report current complete membership before Silver completion.

business_scalar_schema.invariant: Exactly the matching field is populated for a non-NULL kind; all four are null for NULL. Refuse unrepresentable input rather than coerce or omit it.

capability.pattern: Gateway-held delegated identity behind one content-specific capability
capability.identity_selection: One named Opal person, explicitly approved by Andrew before activation; no default identity
capability.credential_boundary: A separate Secrets Manager capability bearer, constant-time comparison, valid only for this exact route. Existing ms-ingest, OTP and MCP credentials do not authorize it; its bearer authorizes no other route. No delegated token leaves the Gateway.

membership.denominator: Every current TRADED_CLAIM plus unresolved previously traded removals/conflicts relevant to the valuation date. Technical enrollment, source absence and missing dates never silently reduce this denominator.
membership.inclusion: A dated contribution requires exact identity, verified effective membership for that valuation date, compatible reporting master and strategy, and a valid canonical value. The current workbook is a claim of business status, not independent proof of historical activation.
membership.exclusion: Known untraded, prospect and blank rows remain outside value sums even if funded or open at Schwab. Every exclusion has a reason; source failure is never an exclusion.
membership.disposition_rule: Append-only protected data correction with evidence and named actor. No data disposition opens an account, places a trade, grants access or changes a trading master. Corrections do not silently rewrite the workbook.
membership.effective_date_rule: Initial effective membership is ATTESTED-only in v1. Only an authorized operator's CONFIRM_EFFECTIVE_MEMBERSHIP disposition, with a validated full account_key and the required effective_date, evidence_ref, workbook_snapshot_id, actor, recorded_at, reason and disposition history fields, establishes ATTESTED membership. effective_date is the first inclusive membership day; CONFIRM_INACTIVE ends that interval on its effective_date, exclusively. Inception Date, Last Trade Date, custodian strategy labels and source-arrival dates never establish activation automatically. A new TRADED_CLAIM is discovered without manual roster enrollment and enters the expected denominator immediately; until the explicit dated disposition exists it is UNVERIFIED with MEMBERSHIP_DATE_UNVERIFIED, contributes no covered value and prevents a complete affected total. The pending claim and operator disposition remain visible in protected evidence. After attestation, daily processing applies the dated interval automatically. Other disposition kinds correct or close existing history; they do not substitute for initial confirmation.

valuation.accrual: Use the existing declared canonical basis; the source's zero accrued_income placeholder is not evidence that actual accrual is zero. Preserve the PENDING-RULING limitation; do not redefine basis or add unverified accrual.
valuation.observation_key: SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing full account key, valuation date, source versions/hashes, workbook snapshot, effective-membership disposition version and basis version; omit ingestion clock and run UUID so retries are stable.
valuation.gold_partition_policy: One immutable data.parquet per UTC knowledge date. Conditional create; an existing identical observation is NO_CHANGE. Changed knowledge after that object exists is queued for the next UTC date. Never replace it or mint another leaf for the same date.
valuation.correction_resolution: For each account and valuation date, select the latest knowledge-date observation through an acyclic explicit supersedes chain. Competing corrections or duplicate observation IDs with different payloads are errors, not arbitrary last-row-wins.
valuation.snapshot_aggregation: Resolve all account observations for a valuation date first, then aggregate. Never select one newest partition and mistake a correction-only partition for a complete cohort.
valuation.gold_partition_label: date={knowledge_date}; UTC knowledge date, never the row valuation_date

categories.firm_rule: 49financial base must exclude Tax before Tax is added once. Client remains unchanged. Preserve source_basis in every reconstructed entry; refuse missing or incompatible basis.
categories.global_rule: Global folds the completed firm contributions once. Tax is exposed as the sum of firm Tax leaves, never added again on top of firm totals that already include it.
categories.overlap_rule: Exact full-ID overlap against the base membership for the same valuation date blocks the affected total until evidence resolves its basis. No inferred netting or automatic Client carve-out.
categories.incomplete_rule: Unknown/stale Tax remains a visible dated leaf and makes dependent SMA, ALT Strategies, 49financial and Global complete totals unavailable. An explicitly labelled confirmed subtotal or dated last complete figure may be shown, never as the complete current total. Unrelated firms and Client retain their existing meaning.
categories.wire_privacy: Aggregate counts/status/date only. No account identifiers, names or row-level evidence in ordinary category JSON or the portal.

wire_extension.rollout_rule: Enable new served payload only with a compatible consumer in the same environment; production activation waits for its applicable promotion authorization.

operations.gold_schedule: Existing mdpf-scheduled-floor at 13:30 UTC every calendar day; acquire/reconcile Tax before the 49financial/Global category stage in that invocation.
operations.publisher_schedule: Existing 13:50 UTC daily publisher; reads observed completion/status rather than assuming 20 minutes proves completion.
operations.freshness_basis: Existing MDPF trading-calendar binding with the canonical exchange calendar. Compare source valuation dates to the expected completed trading session; weekends and holidays advance knowledge processing, not the valuation date.
operations.correction_latency: Next daily partition after the change is known when today's object already exists; nominal at most one day. Missed executions are operational delay, explicitly STALE with pending_since, never hidden by advancing a date.
operations.status_control: Protected versioned control state carries pending changes, auth/source errors and run receipts. Publisher may read this for status only; all numerical business values come from canonical Gold parquet. Status must never supply a second value or membership authority.

reader_moments.pending_corrections: Tax prelude reads on every scheduled or controlled operator run; publisher reads before each daily publication.
reader_moments.run_receipts: COO's existing project/operator review reads the latest receipt at the daily MDPF check and before approving a rerun or close.
reader_moments.served_status: Model Portfolios category reader reads on each load and explicit refresh; accessor must not serve a one-hour hidden cached failure.
reader_moments.audit: Gateway owner reads the relevant request IDs during access/revocation review and incident recovery; project validation reconciles every controlled call to its audit receipt.

operations.cache_policy: Category accessor cache TTL at most five minutes; do not cache failures or incomplete transport responses as successful data. Explicit refresh bypasses accessor and query caches; UI retains truthful source dates and stale status even before refresh.
operations.recovery: Idempotent staged computation, conditional Gold creation, publisher destination readback, and repair of missing/corrupt destination despite unchanged source hash. Repair through the same publisher and canonical served key. No standing comparator, alternate served tree, new monitor or trading side effect.
operations.l6_release: HELD pending both current v0.3 F1-F3 signatures. Andrew has answered E1/E2: X7 CONDITIONAL and X2 PERMANENT are GRANTED at9cf4a274db (CTO97126). Once both halves are signed the L6 hold lifts; no further Andrew answer is owed for these exceptions. Paper L5 may continue; no task orders or workers before the current-half signatures. The separate S16 named-person content-activation prerequisite is unchanged.

field_types.account_key: string; validated full canonical form; protected only
field_types.value_usd: nullable parquet decimal128(20,2); JSON finite USD number rounded only at display; reject NaN/Infinity
field_types.counts: nonnegative integers; expected_accounts nullable only when denominator unknown
field_types.reason_codes: array of unique reason_codes enum members; compound failures preserved
field_types.snapshot_id: SHA-256 of stable source identity, ETag and projected payload
field_types.nullable_rule: Every unavailable complete amount carries its status/reasons; null is never coerced to zero
field_types.technical_enrollment: status axis only; cannot gate canonical Schwab daily membership
field_types.response_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact successful capability JSON response body bytes; retained in Bronze object metadata and Silver lineage, separate from the logical snapshot_id.
